name: A Vampire's Revenge
source:
A horrible night that once led you to leave your hometown for four years comes back to haunt you – but why?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
四年前，一個可怕的夜晚讓你離開了家鄉。如今，那一夜的陰影又纏上了你——可這是為什麼？
